$comment: Per-locale count of shipped keys that drift from their termbase ruling (docs/i18n/<tag>/terms.json), read by i18n-check-termbase.ts. A locale may carry up to its number without a warning; local runs ratchet it down and drop a locale that lost its terms.json. A locale not listed is strict. decisionsBytes: the byte size each locale's decisions.md may not grow past, so the file stays distilled rulings rather than a journal; local runs ratchet it down, record a locale's first decisions.md at its size, and drop one that's gone. Raising a drift number needs David's OK (scripts/check/checks/DETAILS.md § Allowlist consent); bump a decisionsBytes number when new decisions need room.
